options.text: Inversion: 'No sooner had he arrived than...'
options.rationale: Correct: 'No sooner' at the front triggers subject-auxiliary inversion with 'than'.
No inversion and wrong linker; this is ungrammatical.
Wrong verb form and no inversion.

items.stem: A C2 listening item tests implied attitude. The best strategy is to:

options.text: Infer stance from tone, lexis and what is left unsaid
options.rationale: Correct: C2 listening rewards inference beyond literal content.

options.text: Select the option that repeats the speaker's words
options.rationale: Literal word-matching ignores the implied meaning being tested.

options.text: Assume the first opinion stated is the answer
options.rationale: Order is not a reliable cue for implied attitude.

options.text: Ignore tone and focus only on facts
options.rationale: Tone is central to attitude items.

items.explanation: Correct: C2 listening rewards inference beyond literal content.
